## What changed

Describe the idea, research evidence, or maintenance change.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I searched the repository and relevant public sources for equivalent work.
- [ ] I linked evidence for problem claims and existing approaches.
- [ ] I described a material gap rather than renaming an existing project.
- [ ] I ran `node tools/validate-ideas.mjs` when changing `ideas/`.
- [ ] I did not add text copied from a source or language-model output presented as research.
